correctness.rationale: The Weibull extreme level h_n=(log n)^(1/β), spacing b_n=h_n^(1−β)/β, and Gamma service fluctuation √h_n yield b_n/√h_n→∞,2,0 for β<1/2,=1/2,>1/2. Poisson extremal points with a Gaussian service mark give agreement probability 1 in the first regime and critical score x+g/2 in the middle. A Chernoff bound plus e^(Cs−c(s−K)^2) integrability excludes low-workload intruders when β≤1/2. At β>1/2 the expected number of rival jobs in [h_n−√h_n,h_n−√h_n/2] diverges, with independent Gaussian-tail chances to beat the workload winner. The Poisson winner void probability is 1/(1+A(g)); completing a square gives A(g)=exp(1/8−g/2)Φ̄(g−1/2)−Φ̄(g). Independent Simpson integration independently obtained p*=0.7444140829247499, matching the stated 0.744414083. Finite numerical integral is not proof of PPP convergence or intrusion cutoff; both were examined analytically.
